annotations.title: Reverse geocode many US points to Census geography

description: Reverse geocode many US points to Census geography — Up to 25 US points (lat,lon or label=lat,lon separated by ;) to state, state FIPS, county and census tract in one call, with a rollup by state and county, distinct tract count and points sharing a tract. Points outside the US are reported as unresolved. Source: US Census Bureau geocoder (public domain). JSON. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: geo_reverse_batch
